Trần Phú and Cẩm Kim, Hội An

Building outlines and carriageway alignments are from OpenStreetMap contributors
(ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). The procedural walls, entry
steps, woodwork, shutter slats, lanterns and roof edges are original geometry.
The reference photographs are linked here for comparison. No photograph is
embedded, cropped, traced into a texture, or bundled with these models.

Trần Phú

Vĩnh Hưng Hotel at 143 Trần Phú is represented on way 626704907, which contains
the mapped hotel node. Its frontage faces the pedestrian block of Trần Phú.
The 2015 view shows an ochre two-storey elevation, three ground-floor bays, a
timber gallery and four round red lanterns. These architectural features are
represented in the model. Detail and height are visual estimates.

https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/626704907
https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/2076856055
https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/35952560
https://www.hoianworldheritage.org.vn/vi/news/Khach-san-Nha-nghi/Khach-San-2-sao-457.hwh
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vinh_Hung_Hotel_of_Tran_Phu_street_in_2015_01.jpg

Nearby eligible houses on the driveable stretch of Trần Phú use shuttered
timber bays, shaded entries and tile eaves observed in street-level photographs.
The mapped wall widths and street setbacks control the geometry. The treatment
represents the street's architecture; undocumented individual shop fronts and
current tenants are not identified. The separately modelled heritage buildings
retain their own outlines and elevations.

https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tran_Phu_street_of_Hoi_An_in_2015_1.jpg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tran_Phu_street_of_Hoi_An_in_2015_3.jpg

Cẩm Kim

Christophe95's July 2018 image from 15.870650 N, 108.311714 E looks west
(bearing 277.6 degrees) toward a dark masonry house with a stepped cornice
and an ochre house with a columned veranda. Their positions relative to the
camera and their shared lane are consistent with ways 632392120 and 632392119.
This association is by sightline; the photograph does not establish addresses.
A second photograph from 15.867500 N, 108.322097 E shows plastered houses
on the edge of cultivated land. On nearby eligible mapped homes the model
uses these examples for recessed porches, raised sills, piers and capped
columns. Colours, roof heights and fittings are interpretations of the views.

https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/632392120
https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/632392119
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Houses_on_C%E1%BA%A9m_Kim_Island.jpg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Houses_on_Cam_Kim_Island.jpg
